name: oracle-us-first-acquisition-cycle
brief:
Product: Oracle
Description: Telegram AI entertainment product that gives personalized relationship readings and helps users reflect on uncertainty in relationships.
Problem: People want fast personalized perspective when they are uncertain about a relationship or a partner's behavior.
Value proposition: Personalized relationship readings available on demand in a conversational experience.
USP: The experience is personalized to the user's situation instead of returning a generic horoscope.
Market: US
Language: English
Price: 9.99
Pricing model: subscription
Goal: Acquire the first 20 paid users
Budget: 100
Max CAC: 5
Allowed channels: creator outreach, partnerships, communities, newsletters
